title: Autopsy and Parish
author: E. M. Pemberton
blurb: Odile Pemberton, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
